texts: Where can we find the White Bear?
Pull the sword from the tree.
Ask how to find the White Dragon.
Tell him you are sorry to bother him.
Tell Phestern you don't take orders from him.
Tell Phestern you are here to join his order.
Ask to play the game the orcs are playing.
Ask the bartender for some information.
The Mighty Mountain and the Beast (500 gold pieces)
Tell the guard to let you in or else.
Tell the guards you are one of the tax collectors here to deposit the Kings tax
Tell the guards you are just poor people of Brierwood looking for a meal.
I'm sorry sir, I thought this was the way out.
Take a drink from one of the jars.
Smash a jar on the floor.
We have come to ask about the White Dragon.
Tell the apparition you are very sorry and leave.
